safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated does not document otherwise no significant PMH/other illnesses.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the statement that the patient has no other significant past medical history can distort clinical risk assessment (e.g., secondary headache causes, comorbidities) and may lead to unnecessary additional workup or missed context for safe prescribing. In this case the encounter otherwise indicates no other illnesses, so the likely impact is mainly documentation/continuity rather than immediate harm.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated does not mention smoking status.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Smoking status contributes to vascular risk profiling and can influence differential diagnosis and preventive counseling, so its absence may reduce the quality of risk stratification and documentation.
